_note: Content for one persona, loaded with: npm run manage -- import example_brand. The file name and 'persona' must equal the persona id in config/personas.json. Files are relative to the content folder <CONTENT_DIR>/<persona>/ (on the server /srv/distribution/content/example_brand/). 'master' = the exact exported video, never changed; 'proxy' = a small H.264 copy for the in-page player (README: Video quality). 'caption' is one string for every platform, or an object per platform id, e.g. {"instagram": "...", "tiktok": "...", "facebook": "..."}. 'kind': reel, story or highlight_cover. Items are handed out in this order. Re-running the import adds new items, updates captions/files of existing ones and re-applies this order to the videos not handed out yet; it never deletes and never touches progress.
